spans.s:
उपे {c2c} P. [उप-इ]
1 To approach,
come near, arrive at, reach (a place,
person &c.); लतामुपेत्य Ś. 1; so राजानं,
दुर्गं &c. योगी परं स्थानमुपैति चाद्यं

.
--2 To go to (a
master), become a pupil.
--3 To
have intercourse with (a woman),
cohabit;

.
--4 To undergo,
perform, undertake, practise; तपः,
सत्रं &c.
--5 To go to or pass into
any state; योगं

; to fall into (misfortune &c.);
क्षयं, मृत्युं, सुखं, दुःखं, निद्रां &c.
--6 To
obtain, attain to; उपैति शस्यं
परिणामरम्यतां

.
--7 To incur, be
present at.
--8 To fall to one's lot or
share, befall; उद्योगिनं पुरुषसिंहमुपैति
लक्ष्मीः

उपेत p. p.
1 Come near,
approached, arrived at.
--2 Present.
--3 Endowed with, possessed of,
having; with instr. or in comp.;
पुत्रमेवंगुणोपेतं चक्रवर्तिनमाप्नुहि
Ś. 1. 12.
--4 Blockaded.
--5 Fallen into.

उपेतृ a.
1 Approaching near to.
--2 Contriving, one who uses
expedients.

उपेय pot. p.
1 To be gone to or
approached.
--2 To be effected by
means; ˚उपायदर्शने

.
--3
Assailable.
--4 To be sought.
--5 To
be obtained.

.
--2
To let escape or let go; नोपेक्षेत
क्षणमपि राजा साहसिकं नरं

.
--3 To quit, abandon.
--4 To despise,
slight.
--5 To notice, consider, have
regard to; एवमुच्चावच नर्थान् प्राहुः ते
उपेक्षितव्याः Nir.
--6 To look at,
regard, perceive; प्रासादरथा ह्युपैक्षत

उपेक्षक a.
1 Disregarding,
neglecting.
--2 Patient, enduring.

1 Overlooking, disregard,
neglect.
--2 Indifference, contempt,
disdain; कुर्यामुपेक्षां हतजीवितेऽस्मिन्

.
--3 Leaving, quitting.
--4 Endurance, patience.
--5 Dissent.
--6 Neglect, trick or deceit (one of
the 7 expedients in war).
--7 A
sort of भावना in Yoga, q. v.
--8
Regard, consideration.
उपेनित a. Driven or pressed in.

उपेंद्रः [उपगत इंद्रं अनुज-वात्] N. of
Viṣṇu or Kṛṣṇa as the younger
brother of Indra in his 5th or dwarf
incarnation; see इंद्र; उपेंद्रवज्रादपि
दारुणोऽसि

; यदुपेंद्रस्त्वमतींद्र एव सः
Śi. 16. 70.
--Comp.
--वज्रा f. N. of
a metre; see App.
